dossier_meta.statement_text: For every graph $G$ with sufficiently large chromatic number, and every tournament $T$ on the same vertex set, there exists a vertex $v$ such that $G[N^{+}_{T}(v)]$ contains a cycle.
dossier_meta.context_text: The authors suspect that the case $d=2$ of Question 10 is true, i.e., high chromatic number should force some out-neighbourhood to contain a cycle. This is the weakest non-trivial instance of the degeneracy question, since bipartite graphs (which arise in their counterexamples) are acyclic-free but 1-degenerate.
